baseline.policy: Use the current broad-universe EPS-surprise-only PEAD eligibility and score ordering with its frozen universe, next-open clock, notional, costs and exits.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: At most one existing PEAD candidate slot, issuer positive-contribution concentration below 40%, no portfolio allocation and no production effect
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Repository cash-equity commissions and slippage at identical notional; no financing or borrow credit
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: At most one of LLY or NVO common stock; no pair short, option, leverage, inverse product or proxy mapping
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Canonical equity liquidity, gap-cancel, stale-price and FX-normalization controls must pass at the next regular-session open
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Consensus, event, product-level volume, price or mix, supply and signal-day price inputs must all be source-dated and known before the simulated entry open

candidates.falsifier: Reject or park if issuer fields cannot be aligned by product, geography, currency convention and known_at; if the updates are treated as one common shock; if any standard window has fewer than five independent executable pair dates; if no valid novelty axis survives; if H10 and H20 replacement value does not beat cash, SPY, QQQ, unconditioned PEAD and the unselected pair member after costs; or if one issuer contributes more than 40% of positive treatment value.
candidates.hypothesis: For the current LLY and NVO positive PEAD candidates mapped to the same downstream decision date, a source-dated and consistently defined product-level incretin volume-growth measure net of price and mix effects may identify the more durable post-earnings drift candidate; keep PEAD eligibility unchanged, use its score only as a deterministic tie-breaker, and evaluate at most one long common-equity candidate from the next regular-session open over fixed H10 and H20 replacement value.
candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash, identical-interval SPY and QQQ, the exact unconditioned PEAD ordering, and the unselected pair member at the same decision clock, notional, costs and exit policy.
candidates.title: LLY-NVO PEAD demand-to-revenue conversion ranking lead

treatment.policy: Keep PEAD eligibility unchanged. Only when both issuers have source-dated, same-definition product-level volume growth and price-or-mix contribution known before the decision open, rank the pair by volume-led incretin growth net of price and mix drag; use the existing PEAD score only as a deterministic tie-breaker, otherwise abstain. Evaluate fixed H10 and H20 horizons.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: Both earnings headlines and price responses are public. A residual edge can exist only if the market incompletely maps comparable product-level volume, net-price and supply conversion into relative H10/H20 cash flows, and it must survive PIT, density, transmission, concentration and exact opportunity-cost tests.
